name: @pipeworx/mcp-arcgis-lakeland

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search City of Lakeland GIS open geospatial datasets (parcels, zoning, utilities & city services) by keyword. Returns each dataset's name, summary, record_count, owner/org, and its Feature Service `url` — pass that url to query_layer / layer_info.

org_id.description: Optional ArcGIS orgId to override the default (City of Lakeland GIS).

tools.name: query_layer
tools.description: Query an ArcGIS Feature Service / Map Service layer by its url (from search_datasets). SQL-like `where`, comma-separated `out_fields`, `order_by`, `limit`, `offset`. Returns attribute rows (and geometry). Use where="1=1" + out_fields="*" to sample.

url.description: Feature/Map Service layer url ending in /FeatureServer/<n> or /MapServer/<n>.

where.description: SQL where clause, e.g. "STATE = 'CA' AND YEAR >= 2020". Default "1=1".

out_fields.description: Comma-separated field names, or "*" for all (default).

tools.name: layer_info
tools.description: Get an ArcGIS Feature/Map Service layer's schema by url: fields (name + type), geometry type, total record count, and capabilities.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-arcgis-lakeland forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the arcgis-lakeland pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
